title: Dealt sheets stage: pairs of sheets dealt in and out on their own rails
summary: One sticky stage in a section `(n − 1) × 140svh + 160svh` tall, never a pin, where each of five featured runs is a pair of sheets (a ticket link and a print link) on one `scrub: .5` timeline counted in viewports from the section's `top bottom`: the ticket is dealt over 1 viewport from `xPercent −42, yPercent 118, −9°` about its top-left corner, the print `.12` later from `34 / 136 / 7°` about its centre, each pair holds `.4` and is swept off (print first, to `22 / −128 / 6°`, ticket after, to `−20 / −112 / −5°`) while the next is dealt over it, and the last pair drifts into a resting pose (`3 / 5 / −2.5°` and `−2 / 0 / 1.5°`) and stays as the stage releases; the active pair switches halfway through its deal and is announced in a polite status, a ticket that takes keyboard focus scrolls the stage to its rest, the print is a duplicate link at `tabindex −1`; the phone stacks ticket over print; reduced motion cross-fades the pairs in place with no travel, static is a plain list
variants: pairs of sheets on their own rails, the last one settling (this, default)
one rail per pair as its own ScrollTrigger (`top bottom` → `top top` in, `top top` → `bottom top` out) for pairs of unequal length
a third sheet per pair (credits or a still), on a third rail with its own lag
